verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible API server (and now also Anthropic Messages API/gRPC), which lets developers call it using official OpenAI Python/JS client libraries rather than a vLLM-specific SDK — confirmed by docs and community comments praising this compatibility. There's no evidence of a first-party vLLM-branded client library for Python/JS beyond this compatibility layer. Missing for 10: a dedicated official vLLM client SDK/library, explicit JS/Node usage examples, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-language client usage.
